{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ponderweight Division Shockboxing sash''' was a victory sash awarded to the winner of the [[Ponderweight Division]] in various [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]] tournaments. The sash, sometimes awarded alongside a winner's purse, was bestowed upon [[Lobar Aybock]] during his career as a [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]] for championship bouts in both the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
